name: SOC - SOAR Approval Intake
description: Reference Shuffle workflow: receive a Wazuh alert and create a pending response action in the SOC Dashboard for human approval. Import and adapt to your Shuffle version; node IDs and app versions may differ.
_note: This is a reference template, not a guaranteed 1:1 Shuffle export. Set the workflow variables, then map your alert fields in the HTTP body.
